{{Short description|Austrian physicist, computer scientist, sociologist and university teacher}}
'''Ina Wagner''' (born 1946) is an [[Austria]]n [[physicist]], [[computer scientist]] and [[social scientist]]. She is an emeritus professor of [[computer science]] at [[TU Wien]] ([[Vienna]]), where she was active from 1987 until 2011.<ref name="standard">{{cite news|url=https://www.derstandard.at/story/1326502772538/uni-professorin-im-portraet-haette-ich-emeritieren-koennen-waere-ich-geblieben|title="Hätte ich emeritieren können, wäre ich geblieben"|first=Isabella|last=Lechner|website=[[Der Standard|derStandard.at]]|language=de|date=15 January 2012|accessdate=24 October 2019}}</ref>

Wagner completed a [[doctorate]] in [[nuclear physics]] at the [[University of Vienna]] in 1972.<ref name="standard" /> In 1979 she received her [[habilitation]] in [[education sciences]] from the [[University of Klagenfurt]], and in 1998 completed a second habilitation in "multidisciplinary design and [[computer-supported cooperative work]]" in Vienna.<ref name="vienna">{{cite web|url=https://www.wien.gv.at/menschen/frauen/stichwort/politik/frauenpreis/preistraegerinnen/ina-wagner.html|title=Ina Wagner|publisher=Stadt Wien|language=de|accessdate=24 October 2019}}</ref> In 1987 she became the TU Wien's second ever female professor and the first to be appointed from outside the university, and led the ''Institute for Design & Assessment of Technology'' until her retirement in 2011.<ref name="standard" />

In 2011 Wagner received the [[Gabriele Possanner State Prize]], an award given by the Austrian [[Ministry of Education (Austria)|science ministry]] for [[gender studies]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bmbwf.gv.at/das-ministerium/alt-staatspreise-und-auszeichnungen/gabriele-possanner-staats-wuerdigungs-und-foerderungspreise/wagner/|title=Gabriele Possanner-Staatspreisträgerin 2011|publisher=Bundesministerium für Bildung, Wissenschaft und Forschung|language=de|accessdate=24 October 2019|archive-date=24 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191024201628/https://bmbwf.gv.at/das-ministerium/alt-staatspreise-und-auszeichnungen/gabriele-possanner-staats-wuerdigungs-und-foerderungspreise/wagner/|url-status=dead}}</ref> and the city of [[Vienna]]'s Women's Award.<ref name="vienna" /> She is a current member of the [[Chancellery (Austria)|Austrian Chancellery]]'s [[bioethics]] commission<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bundeskanzleramt.gv.at/en/topics/bioethics-commission/members-bioethics.html?lang=en|title=Members of the Bioethics Commission|publisher=Federal Chancellery|language=en|accessdate=24 October 2019}}</ref> and a former member of the ''European Group on Ethics in Science and New Technologies''.<ref name="standard" />
